tagline: Covering the World in Paint and Coatings.
hero_kpi_rationale: Gross margin is a key indicator of profitability in the paint and coatings sector, reflecting the company's ability to manage production costs and pricing. It is essential for funding investments and growth.

kpis.explanation: Difference between net revenue and cost of goods sold, expressed as a percentage of net revenue.
kpis.description: Consolidated gross margin increased in 2025, primarily due to favorable selling prices in the Paint Stores Group segment, the acquisition of Suvinil, and moderated raw material costs.
kpis.signal: Improved gross margin driven by pricing and cost management.

kpis.explanation: Total sales amount after deduction of returns, discounts, and allowances.
kpis.description: Consolidated net revenue increased by 2.1% in 2025, primarily due to higher sales in the Paint Stores and Consumer Brands groups, despite some demand volatility.
kpis.signal: Moderate net revenue growth driven by the Paint Stores and Consumer Brands segments.

kpis.explanation: Revenue generated by the company-operated specialty paint stores.
kpis.description: The Paint Stores Group segment saw net sales increase by 3.2% in 2025, primarily due to higher selling prices, partially offset by a slight decline in sales volume.
kpis.signal: Strong growth in the core paint stores segment, driven by pricing.

kpis.explanation: Revenue from paint and coating products sold to consumers.
kpis.description: The Consumer Brands Group segment increased net sales by 1.9% in 2025, primarily due to the acquisition of Suvinil, partially offset by an unfavorable foreign exchange impact.
kpis.signal: Growth in the consumer brands segment supported by an acquisition.

kpis.explanation: Revenue from specialized paints and coatings for industrial and professional applications.
kpis.description: Net sales in the Performance Coatings Group segment remained flat in 2025 compared to 2024, as favorable impacts from acquisitions and currency were offset by unfavorable pricing effects due to product mix.
kpis.signal: Stagnation in the performance coatings segment, impacted by product mix.

kpis.explanation: Cash generated from the company's operating activities.
kpis.description: The company generated $3.452 billion in operating cash flow in 2025, representing 14.6% of net revenue, demonstrating strong cash generation capability.
kpis.signal: Strong operating cash flow generation, a sign of financial health.

kpis.explanation: Selling, general and administrative expenses as a percentage of net revenue.
kpis.description: Selling, general and administrative expenses represented 32.6% of net revenue in 2025, a slight increase compared to 2024, indicating continued investments in operations and growth.
kpis.signal: Slight increase in SG&A expenses, reflecting investments in growth.

kpis.explanation: Amount invested in tangible and intangible assets.
kpis.description: Capital expenditures are not explicitly detailed in the provided excerpts for the year 2025.
kpis.signal: Information not available in the provided 10-K.

kpis.explanation: Total number of specialty paint stores operated by the company.
kpis.description: The total number of Paint Stores Group locations reached 4,853 at the end of 2025, with a growth target of approximately 2% per year.
kpis.signal: Ongoing expansion of the store network, a growth driver.

kpis.explanation: Financial impact of the Suvinil acquisition on net sales.
kpis.description: The acquisition of Suvinil in October 2025 contributed $164.5 million to the Consumer Brands group's net sales.
kpis.signal: The Suvinil acquisition significantly contributed to sales growth in 2025.

kpis.explanation: Number of new stores opened minus closures by the Paint Stores Group.
kpis.description: During 2025, the Paint Stores Group opened 83 new stores and closed 3, resulting in a net increase of 80 stores.
kpis.signal: Continued expansion of the store network.

kpis.explanation: Total amount paid in dividends per share over the fiscal year. Key indicator for income-oriented investors.
kpis.description: 5-year history of declared dividends per share (2021-2025).

kpis.explanation: Annual total cash returned to shareholders: dividends paid + share buybacks (treasury stock).
kpis.description: For 2025: cumulative dividends + share buybacks in billions USD.

kpis.explanation: Share of net income redistributed as dividends. Above 80% indicates a potentially unsustainable dividend.
kpis.description: Dividends / net income for 2025 (based on net income attributable to shareholders).

risks.title: Foreign currency fluctuations
risks.score_rationale: Risk disclosed in initial position of report (Item 1A) with moderate language ('may affect'). Worsening trend: negative impact of 0.1% on 2025 sales and FX loss of $65.6M vs gain of $44.7M in 2024. Macro category with standard weighting.

risks.title: Supply chain disruptions
risks.score_rationale: Risk cited in initial position (Item 1A) among key macroeconomic factors. Moderate language ('may affect'). Stable to improving trend: raw material costs moderate in 2025 vs 2024. Standard macro weighting.

risks.title: Acquisition-related risks
risks.score_rationale: Major implicit risk: Suvinil acquisition of $1.15Bn in October 2025 generates complex integration, amortization of $0.78 per share and brand impairment of $17.8M. Central position in results. New and worsening trend from this significant acquisition.

risks.title: Debt and interest expense
risks.score_rationale: Risk in central position of financial report. Factual language but material impact: total debt $10.871Bn, 2.4x EBITDA ratio, interest charges up $49.3M (+11.8%) in 2025. Worsening trend driven by acquisitions and new facilities. Strong credit weighting.

risks.title: Declining segment profitability
risks.score_rationale: Risk in central position: Consumer Brands Group pre-tax income down 13.6% and Performance Coatings down 8.3% in 2025. Factual language but worsening trend. Brand impairment and ongoing restructuring. Strong industrial weighting.

risks.title: Restructuring and asset impairment
risks.score_rationale: Risk in central position: impairment of $17.8M in 2025 (vs zero in 2024) on brands in Asia, Latin America and Europe. Ongoing restructuring with severance costs of $0.34 per share. New and worsening trend. Standard industrial weighting.

risks.title: Rising operating costs
risks.score_rationale: Risk in central position: SG&A up $272.9M (+3.7%) driven by salary costs, new stores and facilities. Factual language. Worsening trend: SG&A moves from 32.1% to 32.6% of sales. Standard macro weighting.

ai_positioning.summary: The company SHW does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing.
